newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hwa Kay Thai to place 400 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Hwa Kay Thai to place 400 mln warrants.

text.p: Hwa Kay Thai Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to privately place 400 million 1996-1998 warrants at HK$0.075 each to independent third parties to raise HK$27.4 million after expenses.
The warrants have a strike price of HK$0.75, which represents a premium of 17.86 percent to the stock's close of HK$0.70 per share on Friday, it said.
Hwa Kay Thai said it will issue a total of 400 million shares respresenting about 19.79 percent of the existing issued share capital if the warrants are fully exercised.
Dealing in the warrants will start on December 30.
The proceeds will be used in part to build upon the recent restructuring of its restaurant division and to invest in fast food operations in Shanghai, the company said.
They will also be used to develop its distribution and marketing division.
Hwa Kay Thai distributes Puma brand products in addition to operating restaurants. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
